intro.title: Manage language, backups, and offline data from one place.
intro.copy: Use this page to change app preferences, back up device-local data, and inspect the installed OPTC packs on this device.

language.label: Language
language.helper: Change the app language live and keep it persisted on this device.

analytics.title: Analytics & cookies
analytics.copy: Google Analytics stays off until you allow optional analytics cookies for this browser.
analytics.helper: You can change this choice at any time. Rejecting keeps optional analytics cookies disabled.

performance.title: Auto Team Builder performance
performance.copy: Control how many web workers the auto team builder uses while scanning fallback attempts.

runtime.auto: Auto mode reserves one detected core for the UI when possible and applies only to fallback scans.
runtime.effective: Fallback scans will use up to {{count}} web worker(s).
runtime.manual: Manual mode uses the selected worker count only for fallback scans.

management.copy: Back up and restore the device-local data used by favorite characters, favorite ships, saved teams, and saved enemies.

confirm.deleteFavorites: Delete all favorites? This does not affect your saved teams or saved enemies.
confirm.deleteFavoriteShips: Delete all favorite ships? This does not affect your favorite characters, saved teams, or saved enemies.
confirm.deleteSavedEnemies: Delete all saved enemies? This does not affect your favorites or saved teams.
confirm.deleteSavedTeams: Delete all saved teams? This does not affect your favorites or saved enemies.

allData.copy: Export a full device backup bundle or import a smart backup that can contain all data, only one section, or even a single saved team or saved enemy export.

errors.invalidJson: The selected backup file is not valid JSON.
errors.invalidPayload: The selected backup file does not match a supported all-data or single-section backup format.
errors.unsupportedSchema: The selected backup file uses an unsupported backup schema.

feedback.warningTitle: All data import completed with warnings

allData.title: All Data

favorites.copy: Export or import your OPTCbx-compatible favorites file, or clear the full favorites list on this device.
favorites.title: Favorites

favoriteShips.copy: Export all favorite ships as JSON, import a favorite ships backup, or clear the full favorite ships list from this device.

errors.invalidJson: The selected ship backup is not valid JSON.
errors.invalidPayload: The selected ship backup does not match the expected favorite ships format.
errors.unsupportedSchema: The selected ship backup uses an unsupported schema version.

feedback.warningTitle: Favorite ships import completed with warnings

favoriteShips.title: Favorite Ships

savedEnemies.copy: Export all saved enemies as JSON, import a saved enemies backup, or delete every saved enemy from this device.
savedEnemies.title: Saved Enemies

savedTeams.copy: Export all saved teams as JSON, import a saved teams backup, or delete every saved team from this device.
savedTeams.title: Saved Teams

release.copy: The technical pipeline is ready for local offline use, but redistribution of game art remains a separate legal and product decision before any public store release.
